auth.quote: Use the OAuth 2.0 protocol to implement authentication and authorization. Authorization is essential for both testing via sandbox companies and production apps.

access.quote: You can start with the sandbox company connected to your Intuit Developer account. This gives you sample data to test with.
The client ID and client secret will be accessible only after completing the Production Key questionnaire and its approval.
To publish an App, you must first complete a self-attested assessment questionnaire. Upon approval, your App moves to production, allowing you to begin connecting with customers.
Utilize the Builder Tier to take advantage of the Intuit Developer Platform’s offerings without any monetary commitment.

api.quote: The QuickBooks Online Accounting API utilizes the REST architecture and GraphQL so you can seamlessly integrate your app with QuickBooks Online and the Intuit Financial Ecosystem.
Silver, Gold, and Platinum partners have access to Premium APIs including the Projects API, Custom Fields API, Sales Tax API, and Payroll Compensation API.
It includes full CRUD operations for 29 entity types and 11 financial reports

mcp.quote: Note: this is a local MCP server. It runs as a stdio subprocess on the developer's or partner's machine and authenticates to a QuickBooks Online company.

buildability.quote: Tip : Remember, the client ID and client secret for Production work only for live, in-production apps. Those for Development are only for your sandbox companies.

uncertain.mcp: Intuit hosts an MCP URL (mcp.quickbooks.intuit.com/mcp) but it is an invitation-only pilot for App Partner Program partners, and Intuit also runs the end-user QuickBooks connector inside Claude. The generally available developer option is the open-source LOCAL server github.com/intuit/quickbooks-online-mcp-server. Labeled official_remote because a vendor-hosted URL exists; official_local is the defensible alternative if gating matters.
uncertain.access: Sandbox keys are free/self-serve; production keys require the Production Key questionnaire + approval (Builder tier free, capped at 500k CorePlus calls/month; Premium APIs need paid Silver+). Marketplace listing needs extra security/technical/content review. The developer.intuit.com pages are JS-rendered; quotes were taken from Intuit's static.developer.intuit.com output_html copies of the same docs.

notes: Builder tier is free but auto-enrolled; Silver is US$300/mo per partner-program search results (not directly quoted). OAuth 1.0a is long deprecated. Many third-party 'official' QuickBooks MCP listings are not Intuit's.
